title: Relative Ok
statement: Implement `solve(mode)`. `mode` is `module` when the file is loaded as part of a package, and `script` when it is executed as a file path. Return `ok` for module and `error` for script. Relative imports require package context.
constraints: script mode cannot use relative imports

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A relative import looks up the current package on the module.

editorial: A relative import looks up the current package on the module. Running a file as a script sets __package__ empty, so the relative import fails. Running python -m package.mod loads it as a module and the relative import works.
reference_solution:
def solve(mode):
    return "ok" if mode == "module" else "error"
